scope: local atomic increment of a receiver-relative counter; no network behavior

abi.return_observation: XADD.LOCK leaves the pre-increment value in EAX; INC EAX makes the returned word the post-increment value.

mechanics.receiver_adjust: 0x14: ADD ECX,0x14 adjusts the receiver before any memory operand names it; it is a this-pointer adjustment, not a field read
mechanics.atomic_operation: XADD.LOCK dword ptr [ECX],EAX with EAX=1: the dword at the adjusted address is increased by 1 as one locked step, and the pre-increment value lands in EAX
mechanics.return_value: INC EAX turns the pre-increment value into the post-increment value, so the function returns the new counter value
mechanics.field_offset: none: the body addresses no receiver field; the only memory operand is the bare [ECX] after the adjust
mechanics.null_receiver: faults inside the locked exchange at the adjusted address
mechanics.success: returns the post-increment value of the dword at receiver +0x14

structure_evidence.use_limit: Vftable slot membership proves a non-static virtual member of some class and nothing more; no class name, no field layout, and no member identity is inferred. The +0x14 adjust is recorded as a receiver adjustment, not as a named field.

call_graph.note: The xref export records no outgoing call edge of any reference type; the complete 5-instruction listing contains no transfer.

evidence.observation: ADD ECX,0x14; MOV EAX,0x1; XADD.LOCK dword ptr [ECX],EAX; INC EAX; RET is the complete body.
Slot 1 of the vptr-backed vftable at 0x0140a028 and slot 0 of the vptr-backed vftable at 0x01490be8; basis vftable_predicate.

Non-static virtual member: callee pops nothing and no stack word is read as an argument, so the receiver is in ECX and the convention is __thiscall with caller cleanup and zero ordinary stack arguments; confidence INFERRED.
The body has no direct or indirect callees.

model_tests: the counter is read and written at receiver +0x14, not at offset 0: a canary-filled receiver returns the canary plus one if the adjust is dropped
the returned word is the post-increment value: a body that drops INC EAX returns the pre-increment value and fails
only the dword at +0x14 is written: the surrounding canary is intact after the call
the read-modify-write is one atomic step: 4 threads x 2500 concurrent increments through the slot lose nothing, which a plain read-then-write body does not
the machine ABI is asserted at compile time: the slot is assigned to a __thiscall pointer-to-function taking one pointer argument and nothing on the stack

verification.syntax_and_model: passed: clang++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -m32 compiled the source and model test, the package was archived as a static library, and the test binary ran green
verification.instruction_parity: passed: llvm-objdump shows addl $0x14 for the receiver adjust, lock xaddl %eax,(%ecx) for the exchange, and addl $0x1,%eax for the post-increment return
verification.format: not run: clang-format is not part of the worker gate

unresolved_questions: Which class this virtual member belongs to: vftable slot membership yields 'virtual member of some class' and no class name is inferred.
Whether the two memberships (0x0140a028 slot 1, 0x01490be8 slot 0) are one class seen through two bases or two distinct classes.
The runtime role of the counter at receiver +0x14 (reference count, ownership flag, or other): the body fixes its location, width, and atomic increment, not its meaning.
blockers: Runtime validation against the original process is an open capability gate: nothing was attempted and nothing failed.
